reviews_note: Trip.com guest-review snapshots (sg/my/us/se trip.com review pages; Libai from ctrip.com, 5-point scale). score, count, negative = Trip.com 'Negative reviews' filter count; issues = complaints seen in recent reviews.

gz_m5_vienna.tags: Easy to get around 393, Friendly front desk 189, Close to metro 130, Strange smell in room 48
gz_m5_vienna.issues: 48 reviews tagged room smell; no breakfast included; some rooms windowless (one guest upgraded free); small rooms. Recent 15 reviews (Oct-Nov) all 8-10, quiet, clean.

gz_h1_zhipin.issues: 72 'guest suggestion' reviews: renovation and corridor-cleaning noise, dust, slow check-in. Cheapest room has no window.

gz_h2_marhaus.issues: Very small rooms/vanity, river view sometimes blocked, insecticide smell in lobby, leaky showerhead, no food delivery to rooms.

gz_h3_echarmplus.issues: 26 positive in a row. One 2.5 review (Aug): refurbished old building, toilet odour, mould, dust. One key card per room; small rooms.

gz_h5_libai.issues: Odour tag 4 (room change fixed it); 10+ min walk to metro. Free laundry, robot delivery praised.

gz_p1_paco.issues: Mould smell (5.0, Aug), windowless twin rooms, plumbing noise till 2am, leaks, simple breakfast.

gz_h6_yifang.issues: Location needs taxis/8-10 min to metro; dark streets at night; hallway smoke/beer smell; street noise; little English.

gz_h7_yifang_dade.issues: 4.0 (4 Nov): dirty bathroom/towels; worn furnishings; lift via separate entrance 2-3 shops from lobby.

gz_h8_linghui_mercure.issues: No complaint text visible on the page (44 less-favourable reviews, not shown).
